main_measure.name: mean 5-bar unusual move per case (return from signal close minus coin's normal 5-bar drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with day-pooled t >= 2 to confirm; mean < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of the 5-bar unusual move on the signal-bar forecast, t >= 2

decided_by: The day-pooled t of the mean unusual move lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The situation check uses the recorded brk raw value (> 0, long) and the recomputed distance where it is missing, and leaves out the code-added choppy profile; a case is the first bet of each 5-bar grid cell from each window's first row, the day-pooled t uses the per-day sums of deviations with a G/(G-1) correction, and the supporting t is the ordinary OLS slope t.
